stem: ![](asset:P000048-stem-1) The system shown is at equilibrium in a vertical position. The thread connecting the blocks is cut, the block of mass m<sub>2</sub> falls and $m_{1}$ begins to perform SHM. Choose INCORRECT statement:

options.A: The amplitude of oscillation will be $\frac{m_{2}g}{k}$
options.C: If $m_{1} > m_{2}$, then the spring will always be in elongated state
options.D: If $m_{1} > m_{2}$, then the spring will get compressed as well during SHM

assets.alt: Mass m1 hanging from the ceiling on a spring of constant k, with mass m2 hanging below m1 on a string.
